headline: Goal: redesign Gift On Demand Shopify store (giftondemand.in, Kalles 2.5 vintage theme, B2B logo-branded corporate gifts
summary: Researched niche + printmine.in (via Exa; site blocked by proxy). First built minimal "Boardroom" look; user rejected (too plain, few products, low trust, wrong fonts) and chose Bold & colourful. Built gx-* sections on draft: hero (rotating word, live Judge.me 4.72/882 chips, 4 price cards), product tabs w/ gx-card (stars, pack price = price x MOQ metafield, %OFF, bestseller), client-side logo preview tool + PDP handoff, category tiles, Judge.me review wall, why-us, brand story, restyled bulk quote + 8-Q FAQ, floating WhatsApp. User phone showed homepage starting at quote section: save had silently dropped gx sections (25-section cap + duplicate block IDs). Fixed: removed 9 disabled sections, renamed story blocks, recommitted, verified saved state.
taskDescription: Goal: redesign Gift On Demand Shopify store (giftondemand.in, Kalles 2.5 vintage theme, B2B logo-branded corporate gifts, India, INR) to look better + more trustworthy than competitor printmine.in, with feature parity. Intent: raise conversion/trust for HR/admin/founder bulk buyers. All work on unpublished draft theme gid://shopify/OnlineStoreTheme/190542250236 "Boardroom Minimal - Draft - 24 Nov 2026"; preview https://211sm0-bh.myshopify.com/?preview_theme_id=190542250236. keyDecisions: Decision: work only on duplicate draft theme, never publish without explicit user yes — Reason: live store must stay unchanged during review

Decision: build new gx-* sections instead of restyling Kalles sections — Reason: Kalles lazysizes images render as placeholders and markup is hard to control; own sections use image_tag and load reliably

Decision: every trust claim sourced from store's own pages (FAQ, shipping, refund, about) or live data — Reason: avoid fabricated claims; GSTIN 07BRCPA3679P1ZD, free shipping prepaid >₹1,500, 2–4 day production, MOQ from 2, partial COD 30–50%, 48h damage window

Decision: reviews/ratings read live from Judge.me shop metafields (all_reviews_rating, all_reviews_count, reviews_grid) and product reviews.rating — Reason: real data, auto-updates; no 'Verified' label because verified_buyer=false
Decision: logo preview fully client-side, sessionStorage handoff to PDP file input via DataTransfer — Reason: no backend; PDP upload field is app-rendered so attach by polling
Decision: colours via existing god_brand_* + cl_hd/color_primary settings, fonts via fnt_heading2/fnt_bd2 Google Fonts path — Reason: settings-driven, merchant-editable; no new font provider
Decision: WhatsApp number 919717801827 taken from contact page phone — Reason: no WhatsApp number in theme; flagged to user for confirmation
userContribution: Connected Shopify store; chose direction 1 then rejected minimal look (too plain, not enough products, not trustworthy, wrong fonts); named printmine.in as competitor; picked Bold & colourful; asked for draft-only preview; tested on phone and reported homepage starting at bulk-quote section.

failedApproaches: Approach: themeDuplicate of MAIN to make draft → Result: copy had only published version, none of committed-unpublished edits → Lesson: re-apply changes to the copy; commits on MAIN are invisible to duplicates

Approach: commit settings_data together with new section files and >25 homepage sections → Result: commit reported saved but Shopify silently stripped all new sections; screenshots of pending edits looked fine → Lesson: keep content_for_index ≤25, unique block IDs across ALL sections, verify saved file via GraphQL theme.files after commit
Approach: block IDs s1/s2 in gx_story → Result: rejected, already used by bm_quote → Lesson: block IDs must be globally unique in settings_data

Approach: curl/Playwright/web-fetch agent to printmine.in and cdn.shopify.com/store preview → Result: proxy 403 / DNS blocked → Lesson: use Exa web_fetch_exa for external pages; cannot render store from container
Approach: one sed with many -e and /gI flags → Result: sandbox 'exceeded maximum iterations' → Lesson: one sed replacement per line in theme_bash
Approach: rapid theme_bash calls → Result: rate_limited ~60s → Lesson: batch edits, wait via background sleep before large pastes
